plain: Loyalty and duty owed to a country or ruler

webster.text: The tie or obligation of a subject to his Prince or government; the duty of fidelity to a king, government or state.

example.quote: And that the oaths hereafter mentioned be taken by all persons of whom the oaths have allegiance and supremacy might be required by law, instead of them; and that the said oaths of allegiance and supremacy be abrogated.
